let is_leased_rail_carrier (corporation : corporation) : bool =
  subject_to_part_a_subtitle_iv_title_49 corporation &&
  substantially_all_properties_leased_before_1954 corporation &&
  each_lease_term_exceeds_20_years corporation &&
  at_least_80_percent_gross_income_from_leases_or_subparagraphs_a_through_f corporation

let is_common_parent_railroad_corporation (corporation : corporation) : bool =
  is_common_carrier_by_railroad_subject_to_part_a_subtitle_iv_title_49 corporation &&
  at_least_80_percent_gross_income_from_subparagraphs_a_through_f corporation

let is_regulated_public_utility (corporation : corporation) : bool =
  furnishes_or_sells_electricity_gas_water_or_sewerage_disposal_service corporation ||
  common_carrier_gas_pipeline_transportation_ferc_jurisdiction corporation ||
  common_carrier_railroad_or_petroleum_pipeline_transportation corporation ||
  furnishes_or_sells_telephone_or_telegraph_service_rate_regulated corporation ||
  common_carrier_air_transportation_secretary_of_transportation_jurisdiction corporation ||
  water_carrier_transportation_subject_to_jurisdiction corporation ||
  is_leased_rail_carrier corporation ||
  is_common_parent_railroad_corporation corporation
result.reason: Term is defined as any corporation meeting one of eight alternative categories (A through H) joined by "or", each independently sufficient, with G and H carrying their own internal conjunctive conditions.

let is_cooperative_bank (institution : institution) : bool =
  no_capital_stock institution &&
  organized_and_operated_for_mutual_purposes_without_profit institution &&
  subject_to_state_or_federal_supervision institution &&
  meets_domestic_building_and_loan_association_requirements_b_and_c institution
result.reason: All listed conditions (no capital stock, mutual/nonprofit purpose, supervision, and paragraph 19 B/C requirements) must hold together for the institution to qualify as a cooperative bank.

  if is_qualified_facility_or_energy_storage_technology facility then
    material_assistance_cost_ratio facility <. threshold_percentage_b facility
  else if produces_eligible_components facility then
